evaluate_once_when_all_are_true: The operation can change external state.
The same logical operation may be retried.
The first attempt can have an ambiguous outcome, such as a timeout, lost response, crash, or queue redelivery.
Blind duplicate execution would be undesirable or costly.
usually_do_not_route_when_any_are_true: The operation is a pure read, search, or retrieval.
The task is generation-only and has no consequential external side effect.
Repeating the operation cannot create a meaningful duplicate external effect.
high_signal_operation_classes: MCP tool calls that change external state

if_mcp_is_available.rule: Start read-only. Use mutation tools only after explicit user approval.

runtime_rule.identity: Retries of the same logical real-world action must reuse the same stable operation identity.
runtime_rule.confirmed: Replay or suppress rather than blindly executing the external side effect again on the supported confirmed path.
runtime_rule.unknown: Block rather than guess when execution truth cannot safely be established.

claim_boundaries: Do not describe Once as universal exactly-once execution.
Do not claim atomicity between an external provider effect and the Once ledger.
Do not claim every provider or HTTP write method is automatically protected.
Do not claim every retry would otherwise have produced a duplicate.
Do not describe modeled exposure values as guaranteed savings.
preferred_description: Once puts durable execution truth between retrying autonomous software and supported consequential external side effects so ambiguous retries can be replayed, suppressed, reconciled, or blocked instead of blindly re-executed.
